Subject: RE: Missing AWS marketplace payout for Oct — EdgeScale account 8791

Hi all — I pulled the manifest and ran a line-level join against the payout ledger. Key findings: 

- Root cause: a subscription ID mapping mismatch between the ingestion manifest and our payout apportioner. The gateway stamps for several usage lines were tagged with the legacy seller_id (ES-OLD-8791) instead of the mapped merchant entity (ES-8791-US). That caused the system to classify those lines as ineligible for the October settlement run (they were flagged into a provisional state).

- Impact: $37,421.00 in billable usage lines moved to provisional (pending manual review) and therefore were excluded from the Nov 1 payout.

- Why it happened: an automated tenant-mapping job failed on Oct 28 after an upstream schema change in the ingestion layer; a subset of usage lines across multiple SKUs lost the mapped merchant tag.

Actions we're taking: 
1) I've attached a reconciliation snapshot (recon_snapshot_20291112.csv) with the offending line items and the manifest evidence (column: marketplace_line_id, sku, usage_ts, merchant_tag).
2) We will push a targeted settlement correction for the Oct run after finance approval — this will be a one-time payout adjustment for the $37,421.00.
3) Engineering will deploy a backfill and fix the tenant-mapping job; we will also add an alert if mapping coverage drops below 99.9%.

Requirements to release funds: 
- Finance needs a remittance/PO confirmation from EdgeScale (we typically require a remittance advice PDF or a PO number for manual settlement adjustments).
- Naomi, can you confirm whether any VAT/withholding needs to be calculated for this payout (EdgeScale billing address shows EU nexus on record)?

Patricia — I recommend sending your remittance PDF so we can attach it to the settlement and route to Treasury. ETA for a payout authorization once we have docs + approvals: 3–5 business days.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference
